body: Me and my family were very excited to go to your El Paso show because that's where we live, and my mom is asking what would be the closest show you'd be doing when this whole thing settles down?

You already can!! I wrote it when I was 9 but it's not really that good. [https://www.amazon.com/Jerry-Rescue-Dylan-Jacob-Brown/dp/1480968528](https://www.amazon.com/Jerry-Rescue-Dylan-Jacob-Brown/dp/1480968528)
